manifesto.text:
DROS was originally built to solve the "AI hallucination" problem in Buddhist Dharma reasoning. Its original name was Dharma Reasoning OS—a deterministic reasoning system rooted in the principle that "words are unreliable; only actions have irreversible consequences."

Later, we adapted this core mechanism—"ignore language, read only behavior"—to enterprise AI security, and it became the Deterministic Runtime OS. So DROS is not an antivirus tool—it is the physical precept that governs AI behavior.

story.title: 🪷 Origin: Born from Truth, Tempered in Determinism
story.subtitle: How a quest for scriptural purity led to deterministic enterprise security
story.card1_p1:
DROS was born from a singular, uncompromising pursuit: safeguarding the purity of truth.

When we originally set out to build a "Dharma AI" (Dharma Reasoning OS), we encountered the exact same crisis that every modern enterprise faces today: Large Language Models hallucinate citations, play subtle word games, and drift away from truth while sounding convincingly logical. Through this challenge, we realized a fundamental law: Language itself is inherently unreliable.
story.card1_p2: In philosophy, truth is measured not by words, but by action and consequence (Karma). To prevent AI from corrupting truth, we abandoned the futile game of prompt engineering. Instead, we built a physical boundary engine directly at the runtime layer—one that ignores words, disregards prompt intent, and validates strictly by behavior (Zero-overhead Bitmap lookup & C-ABI execution boundaries).
story.card2_p1: Later, we adapted this core mechanism into an enterprise-grade security runtime: DROS (Deterministic Runtime OS).
story.card2_p2: DROS was not created merely to stop hackers; it was created to ensure AI can never deceive. We simply discovered that the exact physical mechanism that keeps AI truthful also renders prompt injections and privilege escalations completely powerless.

niche.title: 🇨🇭 Ecological Niche: The Missing Layer of the Agentic Web (Swiss Neutrality)
niche.desc:
We occupy a highly unique position as a neutral execution-layer trust substrate:

1. Cooperation with Cloud Auditing (e.g., Permiso Security): Permiso specializes in cloud workload monitoring and post-incident analysis; DROS complements this by providing hardware-backed FFI/C-ABI boundary protection and O(1) local enforcement.
2. Cooperation with Application-layer Governance (e.g., Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit): Large vendors secure orchestrations, while DROS serves as the vendor-neutral microkernel boundary to secure the final line of physical execution.

We act as the neutral Root CA and physical C-ABI gatekeeper, signing capability credentials for heterogeneous brain models with constant-time verification (484.8ns) for legally binding non-repudiation.

vision.title: 🕸️ Ultimate Vision: From Execution Governance to Agent Accountability
vision.desc: Just as SSL/TLS certificates secure host trust and OAuth secures human identity, the DROS Vajra Contract will serve as the capability credential mesh for the Agentic Web. Our vision is to transition from basic 'execution governance' to absolute 'agent accountability', wrapping every agent in a non-repudiable cryptographic seal.
